high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @TheCinesthetic, which has a verified blue checkmark. The tweet discusses Guillermo del Toro's preference for traditional filmmaking techniques over digital effects. The text reads: "Guillermo del Toro refused to make FRANKENSTEIN with too much visual effects: "I want real sets." "I don’t want digital. I don’t want AI or simulation. I want old-fashioned craftsmanship. I want people painting, building, hammering, plastering." Below the text, there is a video thumbnail showing a scene with a bright light source and smoke or fog,
